title: Choose Efficient Loading and Writes
---

# Choose Efficient Loading and Writes

RECAP provides explicit controls for relationship hydration and known-record
updates. Use them to avoid loading more of the provenance graph than a task
requires.

## Keep query payloads small

Use references for identity-only results, explicit relationship paths for
targeted hydration, and pagination for large result sets. See [Choose query
shape and loading](choose-query-shape-and-loading.qmd), [Query Resources](query-resources.qmd),
and [Query Process Runs](query-process-runs.qmd).

Use `descendants()` or `under_parent()` for targeted resource subtree queries
instead of eager-loading an entire large hierarchy. See [Trace Provenance](provenance-queries.qmd)
for traversal patterns.

## Update known records by ID

Builders accept `resource_id=` and `process_run_id=` for existing records. These
paths avoid probing by name and avoid an insert-conflict-rollback-select cycle.
See [Use revisions and idempotency](use-revisions-and-idempotency.qmd) for
known-ID update procedures.

```python
with namespace.build_resource(resource_id=resource_id) as builder:
    resource = builder.get_model()
    resource.properties.status.used = True
    builder.set_model(resource)
```

## Group work by namespace

Namespace context controls visibility and authorization. Reuse one namespace
client for a batch of related operations rather than repeatedly switching
contexts.
